integrity: The result is derived symbolically from the focal source representation of \(P^*\delta_t\), the existence of a point with diagonal atom \(\alpha\), total-variation additivity for mutually singular measures, and the standard point-evaluation norm formula for operators on \(C(K)\). No numerical or finite-exhaustion evidence is used.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to real \(C(K,\mathbb R)\), \(\alpha>0\), and approximation by multiplication operators. No \(\alpha=0\) analogue, larger approximating algebra, or uniqueness among all multiplication-operator best approximants is claimed.
title: Exact multiplication-operator distance profile for Wickstead constant-diagonal projections
